# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Draven with a custom-made model after Duxteh2's original community-voted concept for Spirit Blossom Draven which you can find [here](https://theduxteh2.artstation.com/projects/Le4JQr). Please check out his great work and support!

## CREDITS

* Special thanks to [Yoru, Queen of Night](https://www.youtube.com/c/Yor%C3%BBQueenofNight) for the video spotlight!
* Original Concept by  [Duxteh2](https://linktr.ee/Duxteh2)
* Splash Art by [Sobras](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/KOJBgW)
* In-Game Ability SFX and VO SFX by [TriSoundWorks](https://twitter.com/TriSoundworks)
* Casting/Narrative by [Noah](https://twitter.com/RoyalEnigmatic?t=72BZi0e4iO4DfrRSfqIhfQ\&s=09) and [Owlieart](https://youtube.com/channel/UC4f6u-k3Ufcq1rRjdz1TJ1A) with [VoiceShowcase](https://twitter.com/VoiceShowcase)
* Voice Acting by [Matt Barr](https://www.castingcall.club/mrmattbarr)
* Thank you [AnthemLol](https://www.tiktok.com/@anthemlol) for the social media promo videos

## EXTRA INFOS

* If you would like to support me personally, **Bearded Shepherd**, with the models and textures I create for custom skins made completely from scratch, please consider donating to my [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/DanielMatosArtwork)!
* You can also check out the [artstation post on Spirit Blossom Draven's model](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/DAoDv0) for a closer look.

Enjoy!
